description: D4-08 flagship NAV reads, 2026-11-14. Read-only simulateTransaction calls (no signature, nothing submitted) against https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org. Each read retries until every call reports the same latest_ledger; ledger close time from getLedgers. result_xdr is the raw SCVal returned by the RPC; decoded is stellar_sdk scval.to_native.

scripts.analyse.py:
"""Decompose total_assets of two reads with the vault's own formula (pricing.rs equity_of)."""
import json, sys

PRICE_SCALE = 10**12
USDC = "CAQCFVLOBK5GIULPNZRGATJJMIZL5BSP7X5YJVMGCPTUEPFM4AVSRCJU"
TRES = "CCOF6WEYQQUFIMR4SEVELW4AGZAOYMGZCYCQVXN7AFGWZXXVEDPXQ5K7"
XLM = "CDLZFC3SYJYDZT7K67VZ75HPJVIEUVNIXF47ZG2FB2RMQQVU2HHGCYSC"


def addr(a):
    return str(a).split("address=")[-1].rstrip("]>")


def value(amount, price):  # decimals 7 for all three assets
    return amount * price // (10**7 * (PRICE_SCALE // 10**7))


SCALE, BPS, YEAR, MGMT_BPS, PERF_BPS = 10**18, 10_000, 31_536_000, 100, 1000


def preview_supply(st, now, equity):
    """fees.rs preview(): management accrual to `now`, then the performance check."""
    dt = min(now - st["last_fee"], YEAR)
    rt = MGMT_BPS * dt
    den = BPS * YEAR - rt
    scaled = (st["supply"] * rt % den) * SCALE // den + st["management_dust"]
    minted = st["supply"] * rt // den + scaled // SCALE
    supply = st["supply"] + minted
    baseline = -(-st["high_water"] * supply // SCALE)
    assert equity <= baseline, "performance fee would apply"
    return supply, minted


def parts(d):
    c = d["calls"]
    h = {addr(x["asset"]): x for x in c["holdings"]["decoded"]}
    r = c["get_reserve_usdc"]["decoded"]
    btok = c["get_positions_vault"]["decoded"]["supply"].get("3", c["get_positions_vault"]["decoded"]["supply"].get(3, 0))
    b_rate = r["data"]["b_rate"]
    blend = btok * b_rate // PRICE_SCALE
    assert blend == h[USDC]["supply"], (blend, h[USDC]["supply"])
    px = {USDC: PRICE_SCALE, TRES: c["mark_tRESERVE"]["decoded"]["price"], XLM: c["mark_XLM"]["decoded"]["price"]}
    comp = {
        "usdc_spot": value(h[USDC]["spot"], px[USDC]),
        "usdc_blend": value(h[USDC]["supply"], px[USDC]),
        "tRESERVE": value(h[TRES]["spot"], px[TRES]),
        "xlm": value(h[XLM]["spot"], px[XLM]),
    }
    # equity_of values (spot + supply) together per asset; check that split matches
    usdc_joint = value(h[USDC]["spot"] + h[USDC]["supply"], px[USDC])
    assert usdc_joint == comp["usdc_spot"] + comp["usdc_blend"]
    total = usdc_joint + comp["tRESERVE"] + comp["xlm"]
    ta = c["total_assets"]["decoded"]
    st = c["state"]["decoded"]
    psup, minted = preview_supply(st, int(d["ledger"]["ledgerCloseTime"]), ta)
    return {
        "preview_supply": psup, "mgmt_fee_shares_pending": minted,
        "share_price_1000_recomputed": 1000 * 10**12 * ta // psup,
        "share_price_1000": c["convert_to_assets_1000_shares"]["decoded"] if "convert_to_assets_1000_shares" in c else None,
        "ledger": d["latest_ledger"], "close_utc": d["ledger"]["utc"], "close_ts": int(d["ledger"]["ledgerCloseTime"]),
        "reserve_last_time": r["data"]["last_time"], "btokens": btok, "b_rate": b_rate,
        "usdc_spot": h[USDC]["spot"], "tres_spot": h[TRES]["spot"], "xlm_spot": h[XLM]["spot"],
        "xlm_mark": px[XLM], "xlm_mark_ts": c["mark_XLM"]["decoded"]["timestamp"],
        "tres_mark": px[TRES], "tres_mark_ts": c["mark_tRESERVE"]["decoded"]["timestamp"],
        **comp, "recomputed_total": total, "total_assets": ta, "total_assets_minus_recomputed": ta - total,
        "share_price_1": c["convert_to_assets_1_share"]["decoded"], "total_supply": c["total_supply"]["decoded"],
        "nonce": st["nonce"], "last_execution": st["last_execution"], "last_fee": st["last_fee"],
    }


a, b = (parts(json.load(open(p))) for p in sys.argv[1:3])
out = {"A": a, "B": b, "delta": {k: b[k] - a[k] for k in a if isinstance(a[k], int) and isinstance(b[k], int)}}
dl = out["delta"]
out["checks"] = {
    "blend_from_brate": a["btokens"] * dl["b_rate"] / PRICE_SCALE,
    "sum_of_component_deltas": dl["usdc_spot"] + dl["usdc_blend"] + dl["tRESERVE"] + dl["xlm"],
    "xlm_price_effect_at_fixed_qty": value(a["xlm_spot"], b["xlm_mark"]) - value(a["xlm_spot"], a["xlm_mark"]),
    "share_price_1000_if_supply_fixed_at_A": (1000 * 10**12 * b["total_assets"] // a["preview_supply"]) if a["share_price_1000"] else None,
    "blend_rate_per_s": dl["usdc_blend"] / dl["close_ts"] if dl["close_ts"] else None,
}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
scripts.events.py:
"""Read-only getEvents: any vault or Blend-pool event for the vault between two ledgers."""
import json, sys, requests

RPC = "https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org"
F = "CD73M44EYNZOX7YWPSBMITVPERWNA6ZHDLAZ2XSM4RQM6V4XT7GYXFQH"
start, end = int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2])
body = {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "getEvents",
        "params": {"startLedger": start, "endLedger": end + 1,
                   "filters": [{"type": "contract", "contractIds": [F]}], "pagination": {"limit": 200}}}
r = requests.post(RPC, json=body, timeout=30).json()
ev = r.get("result", {}).get("events", r)
print(json.dumps({"startLedger": start, "endLedger": end, "vault_events": ev}, default=str))
